scope: Two-block dense commuting oracle only; no hierarchical, production, runtime, or practical memory advantage claimed

protocol.extension_rule: Run small-lambda batch only if primary batch uses at most 28 CPU seconds and no static case converges before checkpoint 8
protocol.partition: stable sort along feature with largest training range, split at median; no target dependence
protocol.stopping: original full-system relative residual, independently confirmed using dense A
protocol.recurrence: ordinary PCG in fixed orthogonal spectral coordinates of exact whitened operator; true-residual replacement at matched restarts
protocol.work_note: A diagonal spectral application counts as one conceptual full-operator application; actual oracle timing is not a production cost. Dense norm mappings, setup, and original verification products are separately recorded.
protocol.storage_note: All methods retain the same complete singular-vector bank and exact dense leaf factors, irrespective of active k. Both are unrealistic quadratic storage.

16.note: All listed dense factors/banks are shared equally across methods. Setup SVD/LAPACK workspaces are additional; this is not a peak-memory matched production method.
